props.title: Back up, migrate, and maintain your server
props.lead: Create consistent backups, restore or move a self-hosted server, migrate legacy D1 deployments to Durable Objects, clean up unreferenced objects, inspect interrupted uploads, and manage request budgets. Linux and Cloudflare use the same operations protocol.

facts.label: iron law
facts.value: Only one writable copy remains on the same server

content.text: It is a 32-byte random number encoded into 64-bit lowercase hexadecimal. It has nothing to do with user passwords and sessions; when not set, the operation and maintenance interface will always return 404. Each Cloudflare environment uses a Wrangler secret to install its own independent key.
. The model credentials in the backup are encrypted with it. If you change the key, it cannot be retrieved, and the recovery tool will not generate a new key for you.

steps.title: Export to a new directory
steps.body: The export freezes the source server: the database rejects all subsequent writes and waits for admitted writes to clear before copying metadata and objects. The new directory permissions are 0700 and the files are 0600.
steps.result: The returned JSON receipt contains `serverId `, category quantity, and verified bytes; the full list and file-by-file summary are at `backup.json `.

steps.title: Verify backup
steps.body: Check the object, metadata, manifest, parent sequence, reader and dependency closure one by one.

steps.title: Resume when transmission is interrupted
steps.body: Add `--resume `to reuse the same frozen code and verified files. If the source server is reopened, the structure changes, or the frozen codename changes during this period, the continuation will fail.

steps.title: Decide which party will continue to serve
steps.body: **The source server remains frozen after the export completes or fails. ** For routine backup, query the current frozen code number and then reopen the source server; when migrating, see the next section.
steps.code:
node scripts/server-backup.mjs state --url https://showai.example.com/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/source-operations.key
node scripts/server-backup.mjs unfreeze --url https://showai.example.com/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/source-operations.key --epoch CURRENT_FROZEN_GENERATION

content.text: Restore and switch to new host

Backups can be restored to Linux hosts, including migrations from Cloudflare to Linux. The client can reconnect directly using the original account and token, and there is no need to rejoin the project.

props.title: Switch from the source server to the new Linux host

steps.label: export: freeze and export
steps.detail: The origin server remains frozen and no longer accepts writes.

steps.label: verify and copy to target host
steps.detail: Copy the full backup over a protected channel, keeping the original vault key separate.

steps.label: restore to new directory
steps.detail: Existing directories are rejected; new directories are released after verification. The restored database **remains frozen**. Run as the same system user as the Node service.

steps.label: Start and check
steps.detail: `SHOWAI_SERVER_HOME `points to the recovery directory,`SHOWAI_SERVER_URL `retains the original base address prefix, and configures the target's operation and maintenance key. Check `/api/info `, existing sessions, project roles, revisions and object count.

steps.label: unfreeze: only reopen the target
steps.detail: Use the frozen codename returned by restore or state.

steps.label: Reconnect with original account
steps.detail: The serverId is consistent with the user's identity, and the connection, project binding, default connection, and cache are all retained; valid Tokens continue to be valid, and expired or revoked Tokens remain intact.

steps.label: After verification, switch to public route
steps.detail: First use two independent content libraries to confirm that synchronization continues normally and viewer restrictions are still in effect.

content.text:
# 在目标主机上恢复到一个新目录
node scripts/server-backup.mjs restore --backup /secure/backups/showai-2026-10-09 \
  --home /srv/showai/restored-data

# 启动并检查后，查询冻结代号，只重开目标
node scripts/server-backup.mjs state --url https://target.example/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/target-operations.key
node scripts/server-backup.mjs unfreeze --url https://target.example/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/target-operations.key --epoch CURRENT_FROZEN_GENERATION
Do not have two writable replicas of the same server identity receiving traffic at the same time.
If the target accepts the new modifications and then reopens the pre-migration source server, these modifications will be lost.
To roll back: first freeze and export new writes on the target, keeping the target frozen; restore the latest full backup to a new source directory, and only reopen it after verification.
Migrate from D1 to Durable Object
Current Cloudflare configurations use by default
. Old D1 deployments must be migrated before switching to the default configuration. Both old R2 archives and new hot objects remain in the full object inventory.

steps.title: Build and apply D1 structure migrations
steps.code:
npm run build:server
npx wrangler@4.148.0 d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config deployments/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc

steps.title: Install original key
steps.body: Use the original registration key and operation and maintenance key;`SHOWAI_VAULT_KEY `is a protected 64-bit lowercase hexadecimal number.
steps.code:
npx wrangler@4.148.0 secret put SHOWAI_REGISTRATION_KEY --config deployments/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
npx wrangler@4.148.0 secret put SHOWAI_OPERATIONS_KEY --config deployments/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc
npx wrangler@4.148.0 secret put SHOWAI_VAULT_KEY --config deployments/cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc

steps.title: Temporarily deploy with D1 driver
steps.body: Let the source data remain accessible through the operation and maintenance interface.

steps.title: Export and verify D1 source
steps.body: Export and verify as above, then keep the D1 source frozen.

steps.title: Direct metadata into Durable Object
steps.body: POST `/api/ops/metadata-bootstrap `repeatedly, each time copying a batch of data from frozen D1. The response reports the progress of each table, and `complete: true `will be returned only after the structure, frozen code, identity, and table row number have all been verified; retries will continue from the persistent checkpoint. It will be rejected if the source code name changes or the target already has data.

steps.title: Deploy and verify with default configuration
steps.body: Confirm that `/api/info `reports the original server identity and `metadataDriver: durable-sqlite `. After checking the account, project permissions, history and object reading, only perform `unfreeze `on the Durable Object.
steps.result: The service resumes writing on the Durable Object and the D1 source continues to remain frozen.

content.text: If you want to return to D1 after switching, it is not enough to change the route: first freeze and export the Durable Object that is being served, and then use the original vault key to restore the latest code to a verified target.
Cleaning is divided into two steps:
By default, nothing will be deleted in both steps.

. The report is based on a verified frozen backup that protects all revisions (including unpublished and archived history), inventory pointers, quota reservations, and files referenced by upload tasks; the minimum retention period is 30 days, and objects that have no available time are protected.

# 1. 生成报告（删除 0 个对象）
node scripts/server-backup.mjs plan-cleanup --backup /secure/backups/showai-2026-10-09 \
  --destination /secure/backups/cleanup-plan.ndjson --retention-days 30

# 2. 在冻结的服务器上试运行；确认后加 --apply，每次最多删除 20 个候选
node scripts/server-backup.mjs cleanup --url https://target.example/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/target-operations.key \
  --backup /secure/backups/showai-2026-10-09 --plan /secure/backups/cleanup-plan.ndjson \
  --epoch CURRENT_FROZEN_GENERATION

The server independently checks age, metadata, full summary, and live citations again. The frozen codes will be rotated after any maintenance operation is performed, and old reports cannot be replayed; the next batch needs to be backed up again and reports generated.

The service is automatically terminated when it is running: reservations without resumable tasks are released 15 minutes after creation, and unfinished resumable tasks are abandoned along with the shards and reservations 24 hours after the start, and the client will start again next time. To freeze the remaining records on the server, use

node scripts/server-backup.mjs reconcile --url https://target.example/cloud \
  --key-file /secure/target-operations.key \
  --epoch CURRENT_FROZEN_GENERATION

attrs.title: Deploy a remote MCP gateway on Cloudflare

content.text: The remote MCP gateway allows hosts such as ChatGPT to access projects on ShowAI Cloud via OAuth. It runs on Workers, a Container and encrypted R2 checkpoints, and is configured independently
. The build needs to be able to produce

npm run build:cloud-mcp
npm run check
npm run test:cloud-mcp
npx wrangler@4.148.0 deploy --dry-run --config deployments/cloudflare/mcp.wrangler.jsonc

# 首次部署（先确认存储桶和密钥是否已存在）
npx wrangler@4.148.0 r2 bucket create showai-mcp-state
npx wrangler@4.148.0 secret put SHOWAI_MCP_STATE_KEY --config deployments/cloudflare/mcp.wrangler.jsonc
npx wrangler@4.148.0 deploy --config deployments/cloudflare/mcp.wrangler.jsonc
